payload.package:
THE VERSIONED ARTIFACT IS THE REPOSITORY AT ITS CLOSE, and for this iteration the shipped surface is ALREADY LIVE rather than packaged for later — six promotions landed it in trunk during the build, each verified green before its commit.

CONTENTS, by what a user of the lane actually gains:

THE TOOL SURFACE (engine)
  search over two providers — the working tree and any revision, one result shape, context in the same call, bounded in time, count and line width, contained within the root it names
  read by range with the total extent reported, and an oversize read REFUSED with its size rather than truncated
  glob, and a list-files-only mode
  atomic batch patching — every edit verified before any is written
  required-argument enforcement, with absent and explicitly-empty treated as different statements
  an ambiguous working root refused with both candidates named
  a lint registry where every check yields pass, fail, or defer-with-reason
  machine-local configuration with secrets masked
  engine promotion under four rules, and a verification run that executed nothing counted as FAILED
  reopen — re-activates the named states and their cone, supersedes rather than deletes, and leaves every downstream join reachable
  the review rounds injected into every gate's evidence form at the single place forms are built

DELETED, because a package that only grows is not a package: the hand-rolled searcher, in full.

THE RECORD
  15 ledger nodes minted or amended — 4 decisions, 1 owner ruling, 6 risk entries, 1 superseded decision rewritten in place, plus the earlier laws
  11 notes captured, including the full design the owner ruled into its own iteration
  the iteration's own evidence, with every superseded fill readable beside the one that replaced it

THE BASELINE CONFIGURATION
  Node 22 or later, one dependency (the packaged searcher, twelve platform binaries in the lockfile, no install-time script), and version control, which was already a hard prerequisite.
  226 checks green in trunk at the last promotion.

VERSION: this is a bootstrap-versioned engine, not a released package. The artifact is the trunk commit chain, and each promotion commit names its files, its reason and its suite result — which is a stronger version record for this purpose than a number would be.
payload.entry_script:
THE ONE-SCRIPT ENTRY EXISTS AND WAS NOT CHANGED. RUNME does exactly what this state asks: install-and-run for software.

WHAT IT DOES: verifies the runtime version and installs it if missing; installs dependencies from the lockfile only when they are absent; starts the agent, preferring one CLI and falling back to another with its server configuration registered idempotently.

WHY THE NEW DEPENDENCY NEEDED NO CHANGE TO IT, and this is the part that was checked rather than assumed: the install runs from the LOCKFILE, and the lockfile carries all twelve platform binaries with their operating-system and architecture constraints. The right one resolves per platform. Confirmed on this machine — the binary resolves and executes — and confirmed present in the lockfile for the Linux targets.

THE OWNER'S RULING, which defines what this state's criterion MEANS here and is recorded as a decision node: someone clones the repository and runs RUNME; that one act installs everything and starts the system. The platforms in scope are Windows, Claude Code in the cloud, and GitHub Enterprise with Copilot. Exotic distributions are explicitly out. AND: if an installation fails, RUNME may simply tell the user what to install and stop — a loud failure with instructions is an acceptable outcome.
  That last clause is why the one dependency this iteration added is acceptable: its failure mode is an immediate error naming the missing path, which is precisely the shape the owner sanctioned.

THE HONEST GAP, carried as a lead rather than claimed as done: RUNME is PowerShell, and the two cloud targets are Linux. The owner ruled that correct — those environments carry their own setup script — so what is required is that the install be SCRIPTABLE, not that RUNME be portable. It is: a runtime check plus one lockfile install, nothing interactive, nothing Windows-specific in the install itself.
  WHAT IS UNPROVEN: no such cloud script has been written or run. That the install works unattended on Linux is an inference from the lockfile's contents, not an observation. It costs little and should be settled the first time we actually push there rather than assumed then.

NO SKIP IS RECORDED. This iteration's realization kind is software, the entry script exists, and it required no change.
